info.name: NoticeBoardTracker API
info.description: Group 1 NoticeBoardTracker. Needs the demo data (SEED_DEMO=true or python seed_demo.py). Set baseUrl to http://127.0.0.1:8000 locally or to your API Gateway invoke URL. Run the folders in order.

item.name: Wrong password is 401 (same message as unknown email)

exec: pm.test('generic message', () => pm.expect(j.detail).to.eql('Wrong email or password'));

item.name: Same name, new email is 409 POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE

exec: const a = j.find(c => c.name === 'Cloud Cohort A'); pm.collectionVariables.set('cohortId', a.id);
pm.test('Cloud Cohort A only', () => pm.expect(j.map(c => c.name)).to.eql(['Cloud Cohort A']));

item.name: Reuse the plan as a solo track
Trainee sees own plans with progress
Trainee can't open someone else's solo plan (403)

exec: pm.test('task title joined', () => pm.expect(j.task_title).to.include('Read the brief'));
